A Solana dev was up at 3 AM after losing everything on dog coins. All he had left was one banana. He tried to say “banana,” but what came out was “bango.”

He made a coin out of it on pump.fun, fell asleep on his keyboard and launched it by accident. When he woke up, the Telegram had 4,000 members and a stranger named Darren was calling himself Chief Bango Officer.

There’s no roadmap and no utility, just bango. The banana got eaten on day two.

Bango or bust. 🍌
